description: A red tablecloth covers the table, with a blue plastic cup, plate, spoon, fork, and a green pear set near the top right. The right hand reaches to the place setting and slides the pear off to the far right, then carries the plate and cup to the right side and drops the fork and spoon into the cup; after that, both hands fold the red tablecloth inward and roll it up into a neat bundle, pushing it toward the back of the table.
